title: David Matrinez totem
description: A Minecraft totem texture pack featuring David Martinez from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, replacing the vanilla totem with the cyberpunk protagonist's design complete with his iconic yellow jacket and cybernetic implants.
body:
![DavidMartinezTotem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12a8aaee0c9f579e9a1af1f9b40040785ac5067d.png)
A Minecraft texture pack that transforms the totem of undying into David Martinez from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. The design captures the show's protagonist with his distinctive yellow jacket with turquoise accents, cybernetic enhancements, and determined expression. When activated during gameplay, players experience the totem effect with David's cyberpunk aesthetic instead of the vanilla golden design. The texture preserves the glowing animation while showcasing his memorable appearance from the anime, making it ideal for fans who want to blend Night City's edgerunner style into their Minecraft survival experience.
